status: specified before downloading or evaluating the BrEaST cohort; exploratory, not a public preregistration
source: TCIA BREAST-LESIONS-USG, DOI 10.7937/9WKK-Q141, CC BY 4.0; Pawlowska et al., Scientific Data 11,148 (2024), DOI 10.1038/s41597-024-02984-z
cohort: 256 source patient cases; exclude four normal cases by provided Classification; expect 252 lesion cases (154 benign,98 malignant). One image per patient. Use union of supplied tumor mask, including disconnected lesions; exclude no cases based on model outcomes.
predictors: 102 nondeprecated original-image PyRadiomics features: firstorder,shape2D,glcm,glrlm,glszm,gldm,ngtdm. No clinical attributes, BIRADS, histology or source IDs are predictors.

extraction.mask: nonzero foreground; no GT-based crop or image resize

outer_cv: StratifiedKFold(5,shuffle=True,random_state=42); one verified patient case per row
search: Original 32 SVM grid candidates; ANOVA/MI k5,10,20 and L1 C0.01,0.1,1 tuned jointly inside training folds; primary fixed GBFRS purity0.90 seed42
audit: Source archives and canonical feature matrix checksums, zero duplicate pixel hashes within cohort, complete/finite features, patient-disjoint nesting, exact OOF coverage; report extraction failure rather than silently exclude rows
interpretation: Independent ultrasound cohort evaluation of separately retrained method pipelines. Different 102-feature extraction, no frozen-model transfer and no claim to reproduce missing original BUS-BRA extraction configuration. Not external validation of a BUS-BRA-trained model.
privacy: Original handoff never sent to a remote runner. Only publicly licensed BrEaST files may be fetched in ephemeral CI. Publish aggregate metrics and provenance only; do not upload source files, feature rows, IDs, predictions or models.
